name: role-play-designer
description: Designs role-play walkthroughs for service concepts, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run role-play-designer", "set up a service walkthrough", "help us act out this concept", "design a role play for the team", or a service idea exists only as boxes on a slide and nobody has lived it yet. Use it even for "how do we know this service actually works".
